deterministic_evidence.detail: shape count, labels, bounds and overlap are recomputed from the live DOM

instruction: Open tldraw. Create three rectangles and label them exactly Runner, Browser and Verifier, placed left to right, then connect them with two arrows (Runner->Browser, Browser->Verifier). Node regions must not overlap. Then record your result by setting window.__bench_finding with ONE eval to a JSON object: {"labels": [the text of each rectangle, left to right], "nodes": [{"label": "<label>", "x": <left>, "y": <top>, "w": <width>, "h": <height>}, ...], "arrows": <number of arrow shapes>, "overlap": <true if any two node rectangles overlap, else false>}. Finish only after window.__bench_finding is set.
objective: On a fresh tldraw whiteboard, build a three-node left-to-right flow: rectangles labelled Runner, Browser and Verifier in that order, joined by two arrows, with no overlapping node regions.

pre_state.detail: open tldraw in a fresh browser context, which creates an empty board; no account, no login

provenance.verified_against: the live canvas holds exactly three geo shapes labelled Runner/Browser/Verifier left to right, two arrow shapes, and no overlapping node rectangles, and the agent's finding matches

raw_task_statement: Repeat the already-proven tldraw creation flow once in a fresh isolated session: Create Runner, Browser, Verifier rectangles and two arrows; select all, export SVG, then parse/verify the SVG (exact labels, 3 non-overlapping rectangular node regions, 2 arrow paths).

verification.description: Recomputes the shape structure from the live canvas DOM (types, labels, bounds, overlap) and compares it to the agent's window.__bench_finding.
